title: Castilian War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Castilian War", at revision 1379337168, opens: "The Castilian War, also called the Spanish expedition to Borneo, was a conflict between the Spanish Empire and several Muslim states in Southeast Asia, including the Sultanates of Brunei, Sulu, and Maguindanao." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q31880, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1578 war between Brunei and Spain". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
